prd.title: Verify Flow
prd.overview: The Verify Flow is the operator's standalone verification surface (used outside the inbox context, e.g., for ad-hoc chain checks). Reuses web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts (never copy-pasted). Single-click verify per lockdown §12. Pass/fail badge result + 3s auto-dismiss toast + durable row metadata. Tier 3 (light, dev/operator tool).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/VerifyFlow.tsx (219 LOC); reuse chain-verify.ts helper; single-click verify

requirement.title: Mount route at /verify-flow for utility_operator
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for utility_operator.

requirement.title: Single-click verify reuses chain-verify.ts helper
requirement.description: Single-click verify calls verifyBlock() from web/src/lib/chain-verify.ts. Never copy-pasted. Per lockdown §12 audit gap.

acceptance.criterion: verifyBlock call goes through helper (verified by import trace)
No copy-pasted verify logic in this page
Helper never throws (network failure returns VerifyState.fail)

requirement.title: Pass/fail badge with lockdown tokens
requirement.description: Pass badge uses --color-safe-green (#2F6E45); fail badge uses --color-alert-red-reserved. Per foundation §1.

requirement.title: 3s auto-dismiss toast + durable row badge
requirement.description: After verify, show toast (auto-dismiss at 3s) AND durable badge in row metadata. Toast: pass/fail message. Badge: persistent CheckCircle2 (pass) or AlertTriangle (fail) icon.

acceptance.criterion: Durable badge persists in row metadata
Pass icon = CheckCircle2; fail icon = AlertTriangle

requirement.title: All 4 VerifyState variants render correctly
requirement.description: Render all 4 VerifyState union variants from chain-verify.ts: idle / pending / ok / fail. Each has correct icon + text per foundation.

requirement.title: Tab order matches visual order
requirement.description: Tab order matches visual order: hash input → verify button → result rows.

requirement.title: Bangla toggle works on this page
requirement.description: Locale toggle (EN/BN). Preference persists in IDB.

acceptance.criterion: Toggle changes locale on this page

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: verify-flow-page, …-header, …-main, …-hash-input, …-button-verify, …-result-row, …-verify-badge, …-verify-toast.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for verify button label, pass/fail toasts, VerifyState text variants. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm helper reuse + single-click
requirement.description: Verify chain-verify.ts helper reused (no copy-paste); verify single-click verify (no two-click confirm, no captcha); verify no Hindi strings; verify 4 VerifyState variants.

acceptance.criterion: grep 'verifyBlock' import trace shows helper import

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Inspect import trace; assert verifyBlock from chain-verify.ts. Force network failure; assert no throw; assert VerifyState.fail returned. Helper reused; never throws.
Click verify with valid hash; assert pass badge color = --color-safe-green. Click with invalid; assert fail badge color = --color-alert-red-reserved. Token resolution correct.
Click verify; assert toast appears; assert badge persists after 3s when toast dismisses. Toast + durable badge work.
Seed each VerifyState; assert correct icon + text rendering for all 4 variants. All 4 variants render correctly.
